title: Extension by zero adjunction for open embeddings
statement: For an open embedding f : X → Y of topological spaces, there exists a functor from abelian sheaves on X to abelian sheaves on Y which preserves monomorphisms and is left adjoint to sheaf pullback along f.

source.place: Extension by zero is constructed by sheafified left Kan extension; sectionwise direct sums preserve monomorphisms and the resulting functor is left adjoint to pullback.

proof.text: Construct extension by zero as the sheafification of the left Kan extension along the open embedding.
Identify its adjunction with sheaf pullback and prove preservation of monomorphisms sectionwise via direct sums and exact sheafification.

proof_origin.place: Construction and exactness of extension by zero.
